questions.subject: biology
questions.stem: Which plant hormone is made at shoot tips, stimulates cell elongation and causes a stem to bend toward light?

options.why: Abscisic acid promotes seed dormancy and closes stomata during water stress rather than bending stems toward light.
options.whyWrong: Abscisic acid promotes seed dormancy and closes stomata during water stress rather than bending stems toward light.

options.why: Auxin is produced at apical tips, stimulates cell elongation and collects on the shaded side so a shoot bends toward light.
Ethylene is a gas hormone associated chiefly with fruit ripening and leaf fall.
options.whyWrong: Ethylene is a gas hormone associated chiefly with fruit ripening and leaf fall.

options.why: Cytokinins stimulate cell division and lateral bud growth rather than phototropic stem bending.
options.whyWrong: Cytokinins stimulate cell division and lateral bud growth rather than phototropic stem bending.

questions.hint: Think of the hormone made at the shoot tip that elongates shaded cells.
questions.explanation: Auxin is produced at apical tips, stimulates cell elongation and collects on the shaded side so a shoot bends toward light.
questions.trap: Abscisic acid promotes seed dormancy and closes stomata during water stress rather than bending stems toward light.
questions.mnemonic: Auxin elongates shaded cells to bend stems toward light.

askPresets.answer: Auxin elongates cells more on the shaded side, bending the shoot toward light.

questions.stem: Which gaseous plant hormone speeds up fruit ripening and promotes leaf fall?

options.why: Ethylene is a gaseous hormone that accelerates fruit ripening and promotes abscission of leaves.
Gibberellins promote stem elongation, bolting and seed germination rather than acting as the fruit-ripening gas.
options.whyWrong: Gibberellins promote stem elongation, bolting and seed germination rather than acting as the fruit-ripening gas.

options.why: Cytokinins stimulate cell division and lateral bud growth rather than ripening.
options.whyWrong: Cytokinins stimulate cell division and lateral bud growth rather than ripening.

options.why: Auxin promotes cell elongation at tips and inhibits side buds.
options.whyWrong: Auxin promotes cell elongation at tips and inhibits side buds.

questions.hint: Look for the only gas among the major plant hormones.
questions.explanation: Ethylene is a gaseous hormone that accelerates fruit ripening and promotes abscission of leaves.
questions.trap: Gibberellins promote stem elongation, bolting and seed germination rather than acting as the fruit-ripening gas.
questions.mnemonic: Ethylene is the gas hormone that ripens fruit.

askPresets.answer: Ethylene is a gas hormone that speeds fruit ripening and leaf fall.
